title: Do not envy greatness that is sick with worry
summary: Those who appear powerful still carry the disease of anxiety. The shabad frees the heart from craving a stature that cannot give peace.
takeaway: Do not borrow greatness from people still sick with worry.
lifeApplication: When someone else's status starts to dazzle you, ask what anxiety it may be hiding and return your attention to the peace worth receiving.

source.shortMeaning: Visible greatness can still be inwardly afflicted by anxiety.
source.lifeApplication: When power dazzles you, interrupt the spell by remembering that impressive stature can still be spiritually unwell.

evidence.coreClaim: Worldly greatness may look enviable while carrying anxiety inside it.
evidence.turn: Comparison weakens when the heart sees the sickness hidden inside borrowed greatness.
evidence.practicalImplication: When someone else's status starts to dazzle you, ask what anxiety it may be hiding and return your attention to the peace worth receiving.
